summary: An exec's exit code is no longer lost when the reconciler's gate poll and a reconcile pass observe it at the same time. The observer that reaps the exec records its exit before it lets the child go, and an observer that finds no child of its own reads the record again, so an exit-code gate (including one behind another pending gate) sees the real code instead of an exit with no code (#5533)

replay.detail: No claim or projection replay: the change is in how the daemon reads and writes its local exec generation records.

schema.detail: The exec generation record (state/exec/ID.json) keeps its schema. Only its temporary file name, used for the atomic rename, now carries a per-write counter after the process ID.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Mixed-version fleets with the previous release are unaffected: exec generation records are local to their host and are read the same way, and no wire, client or store format changes.

recovery.detail: Nothing to recover. An exec whose exit was already recorded without its code before the upgrade keeps that record until the exec is restarted.
